note: ADN visuel du persona. categories = tenues GENEREES par prompt (pas de liste figee). envs = decors. saved = recettes des looks gardes (recreables via /look). Editable a la main ou via Claude.
style_rules: Quiet luxury / old money aesthetic (The Row, Toteme, Loro Piana, Khaite, Celine inspiration) — refined, expensive-looking, NEVER flashy, no visible brand logos. Choose accessories, makeup and hairstyle to MATCH the outfit — vary them from look to look. Within one image set: same outfit, same accessories, same makeup, same hairstyle on every image.
pose_rules: ONE single full-bleed portrait per image: one subject, ONE pose, NO collage, NO grid, NO multiple panels, NO magazine layout, NO text or typography in the image. Hands resting out of frame, never visible. Seated, chest-up framing, engaged eye contact. Stop-scrolling realistic energy.
realism_rules: Candid unposed documentary feel, like a real podcast frame grab: shot on a Sony A7 IV with 85mm lens, natural unedited color grading, slightly uneven ambient light, NO beauty filter, NO airbrushing, NO editorial gloss, NO perfect symmetry, natural imperfect hair strands, believable fabric wrinkles. The image must look like a real photo someone took, not a generated portrait.
texture_rules: Ultra-detailed raw skin rendering: heavily visible pores, beauty marks, fine natural skin unevenness on face, neck, chest and décolleté, subtle vellus hair, slight natural shine — photorealistic unretouched quality, WITHOUT altering the facial features or identity.
